sentence: This project studies how the shape of DNA duplexes affects how CRISPR tells targets apart.
This project studies how noncoding genetic variants in humans influence the risk of coronary artery disease.
This project tries to find out whether dementia with Lewy bodies and Parkinson disease with dementia are distinct diseases, using post-mortem brains.
This project tries to find out what causes congenital heart defects and how hearts develop and regenerate.
This project studies how tumor cells, their microenvironment and immune cells affect tumor growth and resistance to immunotherapy.
This project studies how circadian and photoperiodic timing systems are organized and how they work.
This project builds a central voice database and provides machine learning and data services for research on hyperfunctional voice disorders.
This project studies how the auditory cortex processes complex sounds and how noise-induced hearing loss disrupts this processing.
This project tries to find out whether cis-aconitate decarboxylase regulates myeloid-derived suppressor cells in prostate cancer progression and resistance to immune checkpoint therapy.
This project studies how the Hedgehog pathway affects Meibomian gland development and renewal, and tests hydrogel drug delivery.
This project tries to find out why people with Down syndrome have fewer neurons and smaller progenitor pools.
This project builds machine learning tools that use electronic health records to predict suicide risk in youth across racial, ethnic, and linguistic groups.
This project tests whether mouse norovirus switches between structures to avoid the immune system of its host.
This project searches for drugs in the microbiome of marine egg masses, including antibiotics and immunomodulating agents.
This project builds instruments and ion chemistry to measure the mass and structure of intact bio-polymers and their complexes.
This project tests whether early detection of bladder cancer in high-risk individuals is feasible and evaluates a rodent model for biomarkers.
This project uses tear fluid biomarkers and machine learning to find distinct groups of dry eye disease based on their molecular mechanisms.
This project tries to find out whether mutations linked to familial Alzheimer's disease impair neuronal survival, and how glial cells contribute.
This project uses statistical and AI methods to find human genetic variants linked to cellular and tissue morphology.
